profile.profile: "Zinda Banda" is an Indian Hindi-language song and associated dance from the 2023 film Jawan. Composed by Anirudh Ravichander, the track features a popular hook step choreographed by Shobi Paulraj and performed by Shah Rukh Khan. The accompanying music video was shot in Chennai with around 1,000 dancers.
profile.profile_long:
"Zinda Banda" is an Indian Hindi-language song and associated cinematic dance performance from the 2023 film Jawan. Composed and recorded by Anirudh Ravichander, the track features lyrics written by Irshad Kamil, who served as the guest lyricist for the film. The song was released on 31 July 2023 as the lead single from the soundtrack album through T-Series. The musical composition process began with the track being first recorded in its Tamil version, titled "Vandha Edam", and later adapted into the original Hindi version, as well as a Telugu version titled "Dhumme Dhulipelaa". On composing the track, Anirudh recalled that Shah Rukh Khan was synonymous with iconic songs that transcend generations, requiring a composition that did justice to his stardom. The Hindi version opens with a couplet from a poem written by Wasim Barelvi and recited by Khan, while the female vocals were performed by Mangli under the supervision of Sri Krishna. For the Tamil and Telugu adaptations, the vocals were performed by Anirudh himself, with lyrics written by Vivek and Chandrabose respectively.

The music video for "Zinda Banda" is notable for its massive scale and production investment. Shot in August 2022 over a five-day schedule in Chennai, the sequence was choreographed by Shobi Paulraj. The video features Shah Rukh Khan alongside actors Priyamani, Sanya Malhotra, Sanjeeta Bhattacharya, Lehar Khan, and Girija Oak. Adding to its grand scale, the picturization involved around one thousand dancers brought together from Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Bangalore. Director Atlee also made a cameo appearance in the music video. With a reported production cost of ₹15 crore, equating to US$1.6 million, it became the most expensive Indian film song ever shot. A separate version of the video was also reshot for the Tamil release.

Upon its release, "Zinda Banda" received positive reviews from both critics and audiences. Reviewer Prachi Arya of India Today noted that the song encapsulated the spirit of the film, exuding grandness, vibrancy, and celebration. A critic from the Hindustan Times described the song as a fun and groovy track that encourages listeners to dance to its beats, while Renuka Vyahare of The Times of India cited it as a standout pick from the album. In contrast, Raghav Bikhchandani of ThePrint offered a more critical review, comparing it unfavorably to Vishal–Shekhar's composition "Jhoome Jo Pathaan" from the film Pathaan and noting similarities in sounding to the Dropkick Murphys' "I'm Shipping Up to Boston" and vocal delivery styles.

The song achieved substantial commercial impact upon its launch. Within twenty-four hours of its release, the video garnered 46 million views, establishing it as the most-viewed Indian film song of 2023 in that timeframe, surpassing the record previously held by "Jai Shri Ram" from Adipurush, though this record was later surpassed by another track from the same film, "Not Ramaiya Vastavaiya", which reached 53 million views. Central to the song's cultural footprint was the hook step choreographed by Shobi Paulraj and performed by Shah Rukh Khan. The signature movement went viral, inspiring numerous recreations across social media platforms, including a notable live recreation by actor Mohanlal at an award show in Kochi. Wikidata classifies the work as a musical composition and song from 2023.

sections.origins_and_history: Composed for the 2023 Indian film Jawan, "Zinda Banda" was released on 31 July 2023 by T-Series as the first single from the album. It was first recorded in its Tamil version, "Vandha Edam", followed by the original Hindi version and a Telugu version titled "Dhumme Dhulipelaa".
sections.how_it_is_danced: The dance centers around a viral hook step performed by Shah Rukh Khan under the choreography of Shobi Paulraj, which led to numerous recreations across social media. Detailed footwork and movement counts are not described in sources.
sections.music_and_instruments: Composed and recorded by Anirudh Ravichander. The Hindi version features lyrics by Irshad Kamil, an opening poem couplet by Wasim Barelvi, and female vocals by Mangli under the supervision of Sri Krishna. Tamil lyrics were written by Vivek and Telugu lyrics by Chandrabose, with vocals by Anirudh.
sections.costume_and_setting: Shot in August 2022 for five days in Chennai, featuring Shah Rukh Khan alongside Priyamani, Sanya Malhotra, Sanjeeta Bhattacharya, Lehar Khan, and Girija Oak, accompanied by approximately 1,000 dancers from Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Bangalore.
sections.occasions_and_meaning: Created as a major musical sequence for the film Jawan, designed to encapsulate the spirit of the film by exuding grandness, vibrancy, and celebration.
sections.notable_figures: Shobi Paulraj (choreographer), Shah Rukh Khan (performer), Anirudh Ravichander (composer), Atlee (director cameo), Irshad Kamil (lyricist), Mangli (vocalist).
sections.regional_variants: Released in three linguistic versions: Hindi ("Zinda Banda"), Tamil ("Vandha Edam"), and Telugu ("Dhumme Dhulipelaa").
